description: Shared metadata for the generated preview China physical basemap. Required land/coastline/rivers/DEM/hillshade assets are present; optional minor rivers and mountain label layers can be added later.

sourcePlan.landAndCoastline: Natural Earth, OSM coastline, or GSHHG after clipping/simplification
sourcePlan.dem: SRTM, NASADEM, ASTER GDEM, or Mapzen Terrarium after resampling
sourcePlan.rivers: HydroSHEDS, OSM waterway, or Natural Earth rivers after filtering
sourcePlan.lakes: Natural Earth lakes or OSM water polygons
